Data Analyst.description: Turns raw data into decisions using SQL, spreadsheets, statistics and dashboards.

ML Engineer.description: Builds, trains and ships machine-learning models and the pipelines around them.

Web Developer.description: Designs and builds responsive, accessible user interfaces and the APIs they consume.

Backend Developer.description: Designs services, databases and APIs that power products reliably at scale.

steps: Complete a free beginner-to-intermediate course (e.g. 'Python for Everybody' or Kaggle Learn: Python).
Solve 30 easy/medium problems on LeetCode or HackerRank using idiomatic Python.
Package one script as a small CLI tool with argparse and push it to GitHub.
Python.project: Command-line expense tracker that stores data in a CSV/SQLite file.

steps: Work through Mode SQL Tutorial or SQLBolt (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, window functions).
Solve 25 SQL problems on LeetCode/HackerRank (aim for 10 JOIN + 5 window-function questions).
Load a public dataset into SQLite/PostgreSQL and answer 10 business questions with queries.
SQL.project: Sales analytics database with 10 documented business queries.

steps: Learn VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting and charts (Microsoft Learn is free).
Rebuild a messy public dataset into a clean workbook with a pivot-driven summary sheet.
Add named ranges and data validation so a non-technical user can reuse the workbook.
Excel.project: Personal finance or campus-event budget dashboard in Excel.

steps: Study descriptive stats, distributions, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests (Khan Academy / StatQuest).
Reproduce a t-test, chi-square test and linear regression in Python (scipy / statsmodels).
Write a one-page analysis that states a hypothesis, test, p-value and plain-English conclusion.
Statistics.project: Statistical analysis of a public survey dataset with written conclusions.

steps: Finish Kaggle Learn: Pandas (indexing, groupby, merge, reshaping).
Clean a messy CSV: handle nulls, duplicates, dtypes and outliers.
Publish the notebook on GitHub with a short README of your findings.
Pandas.project: Exploratory data analysis notebook on a Kaggle dataset.

steps: Learn chart-selection rules (e.g. 'Storytelling with Data' summaries) and avoid chart junk.
Recreate 5 charts in matplotlib/seaborn/plotly from a public dataset.
Turn the best chart into a one-slide insight with a title that states the takeaway.
Data Visualization.project: Interactive plotly dashboard summarising a public dataset.

steps: Install Power BI Desktop or Tableau Public (both free) and complete the official beginner path.
Build a 3-page dashboard with filters, KPIs and drill-through on a public dataset.
Publish it (Tableau Public / Power BI screenshots) and link it from your resume.
BI Tools.project: Executive sales dashboard with KPIs, trends and region drill-down.

steps: Learn common issues: missing values, duplicates, inconsistent formats, outliers.
Clean a deliberately messy dataset and log every transformation you applied.
Add automated validation checks (row counts, null thresholds) to the script.
Data Cleaning.project: Reusable cleaning pipeline with before/after quality report.

steps: Read a primer on A/B testing (sample size, significance, power, novelty effect).
Simulate an experiment in Python and compute lift, p-value and confidence interval.
Write a go / no-go recommendation memo from the simulated results.
A/B Testing.project: Simulated checkout-page A/B test with a decision memo.

steps: Complete Andrew Ng's Machine Learning Specialization (audit for free) or Kaggle 'Intro to ML'.
Enter one Kaggle Getting-Started competition (Titanic / House Prices) and iterate on features.
Document the model, metrics and error analysis in a GitHub README.
Machine Learning.project: End-to-end ML project: data, features, model comparison, evaluation report.

steps: Take fast.ai Practical Deep Learning or the DeepLearning.AI Deep Learning Specialization.
Train an image or text classifier from scratch, then fine-tune a pretrained model.
Track experiments (loss curves, confusion matrix) and write what you would try next.
Deep Learning.project: Image classifier with transfer learning and an error-analysis section.

steps: Work through the official NumPy quickstart (arrays, broadcasting, vectorisation).
Re-implement linear regression with gradient descent using only NumPy.
Benchmark a Python loop against its vectorised NumPy version.
Complete the scikit-learn 'Getting Started' guide and pipeline tutorial.
Compare 3 models with cross-validation and tune one with GridSearchCV.
Wrap preprocessing + model in a Pipeline and save it with joblib.
Scikit-learn.project: Churn-prediction pipeline with cross-validated model comparison.

steps: Follow the official PyTorch 60-minute blitz.
Write your own training loop (dataset, dataloader, optimiser, validation).
Reproduce a small paper or tutorial result and log it with TensorBoard.
PyTorch.project: Custom PyTorch training loop for a text or image classifier.

steps: Complete the TensorFlow beginner tutorials (Keras Sequential and Functional APIs).
Train and export a model, then reload it for inference.
Add callbacks (early stopping, checkpoints) and compare runs.
TensorFlow.project: Keras model with callbacks, exported for inference.

steps: Take the Hugging Face NLP course chapters 1-4.
Build a text classifier (TF-IDF baseline, then a fine-tuned transformer).
Compare both approaches and report where each one fails.
NLP.project: Sentiment or topic classifier comparing TF-IDF and a transformer.

steps: Do Docker's official 'Get Started' guide (images, containers, volumes).
Containerise one of your existing projects with a Dockerfile.
Add docker-compose to run the app together with its database.
Docker.project: Dockerised app + database with a one-command docker-compose up.

steps: Learn the ML lifecycle: tracking, packaging, serving, monitoring (MLflow docs).
Track experiments with MLflow and register the best model.
Serve the model through a FastAPI endpoint inside a Docker container.
MLOps.project: Model served via FastAPI + Docker with MLflow experiment tracking.

steps: Complete freeCodeCamp's Responsive Web Design certification (HTML section).
Practise semantic tags, forms and accessibility attributes (alt text, labels, ARIA).
Recreate a landing page from a screenshot using only semantic HTML.
HTML.project: Accessible multi-section landing page in semantic HTML.

steps: Learn the box model, Flexbox and Grid (Flexbox Froggy and CSS Grid Garden are quick wins).
Rebuild a real website's layout without a framework.
Add a dark mode with CSS variables and prefers-color-scheme.
CSS.project: Pixel-matched clone of a well-known landing page with dark mode.

steps: Complete javascript.info 'The Modern JavaScript Tutorial' (parts 1-2).
Build 3 DOM mini-apps (to-do list, quiz, weather widget using fetch).
Learn async/await and error handling by consuming a public API.
JavaScript.project: Weather or movie-search app using a public API with proper error states.

steps: Complete the official react.dev 'Learn' tutorial (components, state, effects).
Build a CRUD app with hooks and component composition, then deploy it (Vercel/Netlify).
Add routing, a data-fetching layer and loading/error states.
React.project: Deployed CRUD dashboard in React with routing and API integration.

steps: Learn REST conventions: resources, verbs, status codes, pagination, idempotency.
Build a CRUD API with FastAPI/Flask or Express, with validation and error handling.
Document it with OpenAPI/Swagger and test it with Postman or curl.
REST APIs.project: CRUD REST API with validation, pagination and Swagger docs.

steps: Learn mobile-first design and media queries (web.dev Responsive Design course).
Make an existing project usable at 360px, 768px and 1280px widths.
Test with browser dev-tools device mode and Lighthouse; fix every tap-target warning.
Responsive Design.project: Fully responsive portfolio site scoring 90+ on Lighthouse.

steps: Work through the TypeScript Handbook (types, interfaces, generics, narrowing).
Migrate one of your JavaScript projects to TypeScript with strict mode on.
Type your API responses end-to-end and remove every 'any'.
TypeScript.project: Strict-mode TypeScript migration of an existing project.

steps: Complete the Node.js official 'Learn' guides (modules, async, streams).
Build an Express/Fastify API connected to a database.
Add authentication (JWT) and request validation.
Node.js.project: Authenticated Express API with a database and tests.

steps: Skim the Tailwind docs core concepts (utility-first, responsive prefixes, dark mode).
Rebuild a page from one of your projects using only Tailwind utilities.
Extract repeated patterns into components rather than long class strings.
Tailwind CSS.project: Component library (buttons, cards, modals) styled with Tailwind.

steps: Learn the testing pyramid and write unit tests for pure functions (pytest / Jest).
Reach 70%+ coverage on one existing project and run tests in GitHub Actions.
Practise TDD on one new feature: write the failing test first.
Testing.project: Add a CI pipeline with unit tests and a coverage badge to a project.

steps: Follow Figma's official beginner tutorials (frames, auto-layout, components).
Design a 3-screen mobile app flow and share a clickable prototype.
Hand off the design by building one screen in code.
Figma.project: Clickable 3-screen prototype built and then implemented in code.

steps: Install PostgreSQL locally and learn schemas, indexes, constraints and transactions.
Design a normalised schema (3NF) for a small product and write migrations.
Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to speed up one slow query with an index.
PostgreSQL.project: Normalised schema + migrations + indexed queries for a booking system.

steps: Follow a structured path (NeetCode 150 or Striver's SDE sheet): arrays, hashing, trees, graphs, DP.
Solve 3 problems a week and write down the pattern behind each solution.
Do 2 timed mock interviews with a friend or Pramp.
Data Structures.project: Personal 'patterns' notebook with 75+ solved and explained problems.

steps: Complete OverTheWire 'Bandit' to master the command line.
Learn permissions, processes, pipes, grep/sed/awk and cron.
Deploy a small app to a Linux VM and manage it over SSH.
Linux.project: Deploy and monitor a small service on a Linux VM with a systemd unit.

steps: Complete the official Redis University 'RU101' (free).
Add a cache-aside layer to one of your APIs with TTLs.
Measure latency before and after caching.
Redis.project: Cache layer for a REST API with latency benchmark.

steps: Read about service boundaries, API gateways and eventual consistency.
Split a small monolith into two services that communicate over HTTP or a queue.
Add health checks and structured logging to each service.
Microservices.project: Two-service order system communicating via RabbitMQ or HTTP.

steps: Study for AWS Cloud Practitioner or Azure Fundamentals (free learning paths).
Deploy a containerised app to a free-tier service (EC2, App Runner, Cloud Run).
Add object storage (S3) and set up billing alerts.
Cloud.project: App deployed on a cloud free tier with storage and billing alerts.

steps: Learn branching, merging, rebasing and pull requests (GitHub Skills is free).
Contribute one small PR to an open-source repo (docs fixes count).
Keep commits small with meaningful messages across a full project.
Git.project: Open-source docs or bug-fix pull request merged upstream.

job_descriptions.title: Junior Data Analyst Intern
job_descriptions.text: Analyse sales and customer data using SQL and Excel. Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau to track KPIs. Clean and prepare datasets with Python and pandas. Apply statistics and hypothesis testing to support business decisions and present insights to stakeholders.

job_descriptions.title: Business Intelligence Intern
job_descriptions.text: Support the reporting team by writing SQL queries, automating Excel reports and building interactive data visualisations. Perform data cleaning and run A/B tests for marketing campaigns. Communicate trends and recommendations clearly to non-technical teams.

job_descriptions.title: Product Analytics Intern
job_descriptions.text: Explore user behaviour data with Python, pandas and SQL. Design experiments, measure retention and conversion, and visualise findings with matplotlib or Tableau. Strong statistics fundamentals and storytelling with data are essential.

job_descriptions.title: Machine Learning Intern
job_descriptions.text: Train and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models using Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Prepare datasets with NumPy and pandas, run experiments, and document results. Apply statistics to validate models. Use Git for collaboration.

job_descriptions.title: NLP Engineering Intern
job_descriptions.text: Build natural language processing pipelines for text classification and sentiment analysis with Hugging Face transformers. Fine-tune neural network models, deploy them with Docker and FastAPI, and track experiments with MLflow.

job_descriptions.title: MLOps Intern
job_descriptions.text: Help productionise machine learning models: containerise with Docker, build CI/CD pipelines, monitor model drift and serve predictions through REST APIs. Python, Git, Linux and cloud experience (AWS) are valued along with scikit-learn basics.

job_descriptions.title: Frontend Developer Intern
job_descriptions.text: Build responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript using React. Consume REST APIs, write clean reusable components, and collaborate through Git and pull requests. Experience with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript is a plus.

job_descriptions.title: Full-Stack Web Intern
job_descriptions.text: Develop features across the stack with React, Node.js and Express. Design REST APIs, work with SQL databases, write tests and ship responsive, accessible web pages. Git workflow and TypeScript knowledge expected.

job_descriptions.title: UI Engineer Intern
job_descriptions.text: Turn Figma designs into pixel-perfect, mobile-first responsive pages using HTML, CSS, Tailwind and JavaScript. Improve performance and accessibility, and write component tests.

job_descriptions.title: Backend Engineering Intern
job_descriptions.text: Design and build REST APIs in Python with PostgreSQL and SQL. Apply data structures and algorithms to write efficient code, use Git, work on Linux servers and write unit tests. Docker and Redis experience is a plus.

job_descriptions.title: Platform Services Intern
job_descriptions.text: Contribute to microservices written in Node.js or Python, integrate message queues, optimise database queries and deploy to cloud infrastructure with Docker. Strong fundamentals in data structures, REST API design and Linux are required.

job_descriptions.title: API Developer Intern
job_descriptions.text: Build and document scalable APIs, design relational schemas in PostgreSQL, add caching with Redis, and write automated tests. Version control with Git and clean code practices are expected.
